Question: Positive integers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) are chosen so that \(a \lt b \lt c,\) and the system of equations \[2x + y = 2003\] and \[ \begin{aligned} &y = |x - a| + |x - b| \\ &\quad {}+ |x - c| \end{aligned} \] has exactly one solution. What is the minimum value of \(c?\)
